# MODEL: Three-agent recursive branching-time model with 6 states (s0-s5)

# PURPOSE: Recursive branching-time with cost constraints.

# LOGIC: RBATL

# DESCRIPTION: Three agents; coalitions reason about paths and others'
# strategies under cost bounds. ^ is idle. In s0 and s2 the joint actions
# that lead nowhere else keep the state, at cost 0.
